info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Party Asset Validation API
info.description: The Party Asset Validation API facilitates the verification and validation of asset information associated with parties in the banking system. Designed for use by financial institutions, this API allows users to submit asset details for validation, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and internal policies. Typical consumers include loan officers and compliance teams seeking to validate collateral assets before processing transactions. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance the accuracy of their asset records and reduce the risk associated with asset management.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to validate an entry in the party asset directory for the specified party. It ensures that the data adheres to the required standards and provides immediate feedback on its validity.
